title: Kernel becomes an AI expert
caption: Ep 2: Kernel becomes an 'AI expert' 🤖😂 Comment Kernel's next hustle 👇 #comedy #AI #sidehustle #animation #fyp

scenes.say: Kernel's side hustle saga. Episode two: the AI expert.
New plan. I watched one video about AI. That makes me an expert, right? I'm selling a course!
scenes.set: bright modern home office with neon AI hologram screens

scenes.say: Hi Kernel. Can your course teach me how AI actually works?
scenes.set: video call setup in a tiny home office, ring light, plants

scenes.say: Great question. Let me just ask the AI how AI works. One second. Okay, two seconds.
scenes.set: home office desk covered in sticky notes, glowing monitors, night

scenes.say: Zero sales. But the AI wrote me a really nice poem about failure.
scenes.set: dark home office lit only by a monitor showing a poem, rain on the window

scenes.say: Tell Kernel what to try next in the comments, and follow for episode three.
